route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_slot_ctl548/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_slot_ctl548/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_slot_ctl548 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qwen_static_slot_ctl  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: True static normal link controller: compiler-issuedwr/rdslots with fixedTX2/RX1, CRC16 epoch+slot check, no credits/ACK/upselectnormalissue. Any slot/writeownership/timeline/CRC/PHYup error abortsepoch; explicitcompilerdrain/restart. Separate control root and four SRAM store roots; no parent-local payload flops. s2 consumes exact official assignmentbb56cc450 (clkS205..207) and freezes first epoch fault, ignoring only already-invalid idle/aborted payload. Parallel GF2 CRC matrix replaces87-level serial recurrence; dataFF have no reset/epochfanout. FixedTX2/RX1 unchanged. Observed producer valid is fault-only input: missing actual data at a compiled write sets causebit7, no new root or pipeline edge.
